propositions: Plan review must classify every acceptance-criterion checkbox as either codebase-verifiable or operator-attested and provide criterion-specific evidence for the classification decision.

Acceptance criteria missing the exact case-insensitive `[operator-attested]` tag or carrying malformed near-miss tags must produce findings that name the exact required syntax; externally verifiable criteria with the exact tag must be accepted.
Codebase-verifiable criteria carrying `[operator-attested]` must produce findings explaining that ticket comments cannot substitute for repository proof; the same criteria untagged must be accepted.
Acceptance criteria that bundle both repository proof and outside-world proof must be rejected with guidance to split into independently certifiable criteria.
High-confidence evidence-kind misclassification findings must participate in normal plan-review blocking policy while deterministic keyword detection remains advisory and records abstentions.

Frozen-corpus evaluation over pinned multi-sample fixtures including A1, 115b/8c4f cases, and malformed/over-tagged criteria must achieve 100% precision on genuine-external negatives, 100% recall on named fixtures, and macro precision/recall ≥0.90 across the full corpus.
